IMs’ emergence can be used to assess the therapeutic process in psychotherapy and to understand how the client and therapist participate in the elaboration of new narratives.
the therapist’s contribution to IMs’ construction in narrative therapy for major depression should be carefully considered, especially the degree of therapist’s participation.
